description: Public contact details of an Instagram account as a logged-out visitor sees it: bio links, plus emails and phone-like numbers written in the bio. Business email, phone and address buttons are null while Instagram keeps them behind its login (since 4 Nov 2026). Nothing hidden is looked up. Unknown usernames return 404; a blocked or failed fetch returns 503 (not charged). Choose this tool for: Public contact details of an Instagram account. Close alternatives on this server: social_contact_info (Contact details published on one public web page you name); social_instagram (Engagement snapshot of a public Instagram account). Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

username.description: Instagram username (with or without @) or instagram.com/<user> URL
